Changes made by TriviTV

We normalize whitespace and HTML entities, retain four source-supplied choices, merge exact duplicate questions, exclude malformed/conflicting or unsuitable records, normalize category labels and apply conservative automatic regional cues. Difficulty ratings were not supplied and have not been invented. Each retained question records its source file, record number and revision.

Ukrainian translation preview / Український переклад

The Ukrainian bank is a partial, AI-assisted translation of the same source question IDs, marked as draft and not independently reviewed. Question wording and choices are translated; answer keys and source categories are preserved. English-dependent questions may be excluded. Ukrainian games use translated questions only, with no silent English fallback.

Українська база — частковий переклад тієї самої бази за допомогою ШІ. Переклади є чернетками й потребують незалежної перевірки. Збережено ідентифікатори, категорії та правильні відповіді. Українські ігри використовують лише перекладені запитання.

Translation adaptations are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0 with the source attribution above. Download Ukrainian translation data and changes.

Browser testing adaptation · 2026-10-20

This prototype bundles exactly 916 existing Ukrainian Europe-eligible questions from the supplied TriviTV EU Filtered 916 Test archive. IDs, choices, canonical answer indexes and source attribution are preserved. The eligibility manifest marks the pool conservative draft, not independently verified. Server sessions are replaced with local browser state; multiplayer and paid features are omitted. Browser timers can be delayed when a tab is suspended.

Download the complete adapted 916-question pool (CC BY-SA 4.0)

Community content

Imported questions have passed structural checks, but have not been individually fact-checked. Source wording, correctness and historical references may need editorial review. This browser pool uses the supplied EU editorial eligibility manifest. All questions are currently unrated for difficulty.

Category selection

The bank uses OpenTriviaQA’s topic groups. “Newest” and “rated” are collections, not additional subjects; their unique questions fall under General Knowledge. Source category references remain attached to every imported record.
